The Text-to-SQL task aims to convert natural language questions into SQL queries for a given database.

Text-to-SQL has recently gained significant attention in natural language processing and database research . It translates natural language questions into SQL queries, allowing non-experts to easily access data, making it a valuable tool for business intelligence, data exploration, and other data-centric applications.

We use the execution accuracy (EX) metric to evaluate the accuracy of the model's predictions, and additionally report test‑suite accuracy (TS) for the Spider development set.

For all benchmarks, we use the execution accuracy (EX) metric  to evaluate the accuracy of the model's predictions. EX measures whether the predicted and gold SQL queries produce identical execution results on the given database.
